system.description:
He doesn't kill. He ruins.

  • Patron boon: Once a day, plant a rumour in a mind (Will save negates); the creature believes it heard it elsewhere.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Baalzebul in the World of Arneyan wiki.
